description: Returns a read-only fix plan for STALE_CACHE_SERVED using current homepage responses. It reports Age, named cache layers, suggested purge order and HTML lifetime. Purge outcomes are predictions; it purges nothing. When Age exceeds one hour, it compares two cache-busting reads with the served response. Give domain or a report id. For why other findings fired use explain_finding.
